name: The words at the Altar

date.label: Burning Crusade Shadowmoon quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: At the Altar of Damnation, Oronok is told to read the whole Cipher where the memory of Gul’dan stands. The quest presents the apparition as memory left imprinted on the land, not an independent witness returning to explain himself. Once the words are spoken, Cyrukh is to come. A history gathered piece by piece has crossed into the present, and the final contest begins at the place the quest names.
